summary: I don't believe in the future of the web where it will be "saved" with VC money and blitzscaling. Doing the same thing over will not get different results. Instead, I want to return to the roots of the web where it is a partnership with higher ed.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I don't believe in the future of the web where it will be "saved" with VC money and blitzscaling. Doing the same thing over will not get different results. Instead, I want to return to the roots of the web where it is a partnership with higher ed.
